title: Empty output text cost no byte of the retention window, so empty entries were never dropped and their number grew without bound
resolution: Empty output now records no entry and takes no position, so every entry holds a byte; design decision 32, contract section 7, and the spec scenario Empty output; tests failed before

title: A delegation result had no correct responder, because the host that returns it was neither a person nor a standing rule
resolution: Responder adds the kind host, which answers every delegation result and nothing else, else invalid; contract 5.2, spec, design decision 33, and a test that failed before

title: The fail-before run never ran the 24 tests of session-attempts and session-handoff, because top-level generation setup aborted loading
resolution: Generation setup moved into the tests; a follow-up run against the stubbed domain of c88e1ada showed each of the 24 tests failing; the historical record is unchanged

title: The answer bounds test covered only an overlong permission message and an empty delegation ID
resolution: Boundary tests for the message, input text, and delegation summary at 65,536 and 65,537 and the delegation ID at 1, 128, and 129; shown failing against the stubs

title: The contract claimed recordRequest persisted a request before display, though it only returns a new value
resolution: Contract 5.1 and design decision 11 separate recording in the returned value from durable persistence, and item 13 now commits a request before any read or publication

title: A stopped session still bound an attempt, which then could run nowhere and could never bind to the session that takes the handoff
resolution: bindAttempt on a stopped session fails with precondition-failed; contract 3.2 rule 5 and section 8, spec scenario Stopped session, design decision 34, and a test that failed before

title: A standing rule could answer an input request, though the product ports contract records standing rules for permission requests only
resolution: A standing rule gives only a permission answer, else invalid; contract 5.2 rule 7, spec requirement Responder of an answer, design decisions 12 and 33, and a test that failed before

title: The model could not record the host's turn that delivers a delegation outcome after the parent request ended, and contract section 6 forbade it
resolution: A turn author is a person or the host naming an expired or unresolved delegation request; contract 4.1 rule 5 and section 6, spec requirement Delegation outcome turn, design decision 35, failing tests first

title: An idempotent turn retry compared only the text, so the same key from another author returned that turn as a duplicate
resolution: A retry compares the author and the text, and another author fails with conflict; contract 4.1 rule 2, spec scenario Key reused by another author, design decision 8, and a test that failed before

title: Each output append deep-copied every retained entry of the window; docs is used because the vocabulary has no performance category
resolution: Only the new entry is frozen, and the retained entries are sliced into a frozen array without copying them; the session tests pass unchanged

title: A type import of HarnessRequestKind sat in the middle of the port data file, after declarations
resolution: The import and its re-export moved to the top of the file, after the other imports, as in the standing approval rules port

title: No test recorded a request for a queued turn or for an ended turn of the running generation, though contract 5.1 rule 4 fails both
resolution: Two tests expect precondition-failed for each case; they pin behavior the domain already had, so they passed when added

title: A session output test title claimed a property it did not assert, and the handoff test redefined a fixture and missed a blank line
resolution: The title now names what the test asserts; the handoff test imports delivered from the session fixtures and has the blank line

title: The coverage record named identifiers.js in its command but not in its result, and called the changed identifiers.js a new file
resolution: The 7041ebe2 row says the identifiers.js figure was not recorded, the pass 2 row measures it at 85.71, 85.71, 100, and the file is called changed

title: The generation requirement read as if every bad generation start failed with conflict, while only another native session ID does
resolution: The requirement names conflict for another native session ID and precondition-failed for any other start that breaks the rules
